criteria.description: Frames positioning relative to the competitive alternatives — including the status-quo / do-nothing / DIY option — rather than in a vacuum.
Identifies unique attributes AND translates them into customer value (the 'so what'), not just listing features.
Names the specific best-fit segment who cares most about the value, rather than positioning 'for everyone'.
Chooses a market category / frame of reference deliberately so the product's strengths look decisive.
Produces a crisp positioning statement assembled from the components.
